rateLimits.note: E-utilities, without an API key, per IP address; with an api_key: 10 requests a second for all activity from that key (scope key).

provenance.notes: All calls go to E-utilities (https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/). Read 2026-11-10: NCBI Insights (3 requests/s per IP without a key, 10/s per key), NCBI policies (no restriction on use or distribution, submitters may hold rights; a service built on E-utilities must make the NCBI Disclaimer and Copyright notice evident to its users). Live header X-RateLimit-Limit: 3 (keyless). The ClinVar usage page (clinvar/docs/maintenance_use) and the E-utilities book sit behind a reCAPTCHA check and could not be read: the attribution request (attribute ClinVar as a data source and cite a ClinVar publication when distributing or copying its data) comes from a search excerpt of that page and this package README; tool and email parameters likewise from search excerpts of the E-utilities book (userAgent.required stands for them). No data licence is named.
